attempts.summary: On node1 (Ubuntu 24.04), installed rootless podman, created the unprivileged appsvc user, enabled systemd lingering for it, and deployed an nginx:alpine container as an appsvc systemd --user service (webapp.service) publishing port 8080. Verified it serves HTTP 200 with no active login session for appsvc. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline, rebooted node1 natively, confirmed the boot ID changed, and confirmed the containerized app auto-recovered and continued serving port 8080 without any login session for appsvc.
